cells.gaps: No regulation or decree applying the identification law, and no rule made under it that others must check identity against the system, dated in the last three years, is held. A July 2025 decree on assurance levels for electronic identification applies the digital code, not the identification law.
cells.note: Law 2017-08, amended by law 2025-12, provides a biometric register and the NPI (BEN-002), so stage 4. The July 2025 decree on electronic identification assurance levels (BEN-007) is made under the Code du numérique, not the identification law, so stage 5 is not met.
